title: Detailed fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Road -->
  <rect x='0' y='82' width='100' height='18' fill='#5b6b73' />
  <rect x='0' y='82' width='100' height='3' fill='#8fa3ab' />
  <!-- Shadow under truck -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='42' ry='4' fill='#3d4a50' />
  
  <!-- Rear body of truck -->
  <rect x='8' y='40' width='52' height='38' rx='3' fill='#c0392b' />
  <!-- Roof of rear body lighter edge -->
  <rect x='8' y='40' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e74c3c' />
  
  <!-- Equipment on top: ladder -->
  <rect x='12' y='34' width='44' height='5' rx='2' fill='#95a5a6' />
  <rect x='12' y='34' width='44' height='2' rx='1' fill='#bdc3c7' />
  <!-- Ladder rungs -->
  <rect x='16' y='35' width='3' height='3' fill='#7f8c8d' />
  <rect x='24' y='35' width='3' height='3' fill='#7f8c8d' />
  <rect x='32' y='35' width='3' height='3' fill='#7f8c8d' />
  <rect x='40' y='35' width='3' height='3' fill='#7f8c8d' />
  <rect x='48' y='35' width='3' height='3' fill='#7f8c8d' />
  
  <!-- Hose on top of rear body -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='4' fill='#f1c40f' />
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='2' fill='#d4ac0d' />
  
  <!-- Rear body compartment lines -->
  <rect x='14' y='48' width='18' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e74c3c' />
  <rect x='36' y='48' width='18' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e74c3c' />
  <rect x='14' y='48' width='18' height='2' fill='#f5b7b1' />
  <rect x='36' y='48' width='18' height='2' fill='#f5b7b1' />
  
  <!-- Rear wheels -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='9' fill='#2c3e50' />
  <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='5' fill='#95a5a6' />
  <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='2' fill='#bdc3c7' />
  <circle cx='48' cy='78' r='9' fill='#2c3e50' />
  <circle cx='48' cy='78' r='5' fill='#95a5a6' />
  <circle cx='48' cy='78' r='2' fill='#bdc3c7' />
  
  <!-- Cab of truck -->
  <rect x='60' y='44' width='32' height='34' rx='4' fill='#e74c3c' />
  <!-- Cab roof -->
  <rect x='60' y='44' width='32' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f1948a' />
  
  <!-- Windshield -->
  <rect x='64' y='50' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#85c1e9' />
  <rect x='64' y='50' width='12' height='3' rx='1' fill='#aed6f1' />
  <!-- Side window -->
  <rect x='79' y='50' width='10' height='12' rx='2' fill='#85c1e9' />
  <rect x='79' y='50' width='10' height='3' rx='1' fill='#aed6f1' />
  
  <!-- Cab door line -->
  <rect x='77' y='48' width='1' height='28' fill='#c0392b' />
  <!-- Door handle -->
  <rect x='78' y='64' width='3' height='2' rx='1' fill='#f1c40f' />
  
  <!-- Front bumper -->
  <rect x='90' y='66' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#bdc3c7' />
  <rect x='90' y='66' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#d5dbdb' />
  
  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='78' r='9' fill='#2c3e50' />
  <circle cx='80' cy='78' r='5' fill='#95a5a6' />
  <circle cx='80' cy='78' r='2' fill='#bdc3c7' />
  
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='60' r='3' fill='#f9e79f' />
  <circle cx='92' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#f7dc6f' />
  
  <!-- Siren/light on cab roof -->
  <rect x='74' y='38' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#2980b9' />
  <rect x='76' y='36' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#3498db' />
  <!-- Siren glow -->
  <rect x='78' y='34' width='2' height='2' rx='1' fill='#6ec6ff' />
  
  <!-- Front grill area -->
  <rect x='88' y='52' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#95a5a6' />
  <rect x='88' y='52' width='4' height='2' fill='#bdc3c7' />
  
  <!-- Number on side -->
  <rect x='20' y='56' width='6' height='1' fill='#f9e79f' />
  <rect x='20' y='59' width='6' height='1' fill='#f9e79f' />
  
  <!-- Rear bumper/steps -->
  <rect x='6' y='72' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#bdc3c7' />
  
  <!-- Small hose connectors -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='66' r='3' fill='#f1c40f' />
  <circle cx='58' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#d4ac0d' />
  
  <!-- Radiator stripe -->
  <rect x='60' y='70' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c0392b' />
</svg>
